description:
SYMPTOM: in the Panes/Tabs branch the positional claude prompt is appended as a bare wt token ($wtArgs += $p), so a multi-word activation (e.g. a gauntlet spawn-instruction 'Read .claude/MAJOR_PLINY.md. Then git show beadwork:... follow it') splits across wt args and breaks. Only -Layout Windows quotes it ($cmd += " '$p'"). Arc 61 dispatch (2026-06-17) used -Layout Windows as the workaround so the gauntlet (POLYBIUS_the-stoa + PLINY_the-stoa) could be launched with beadwork-brief activations.

PLAN: in the Panes/Tabs branch, pass the positional prompt as a SINGLE quoted token that survives wt arg-splitting (mirror the Windows-branch single-quote wrap; verify wt's quoting rules for a positional arg passed after the claude exe + flags). Add a DryRun test with a multi-word prompt across all three layouts (Panes/Tabs/Windows) to the skill's smoke checklist. Also fix the cosmetic tail message (hardcoded 'Say-trigger: each pane was pre-seeded its bare word') to reflect the actual activation mode (say-word vs full instruction).

OUTCOME: a gauntlet can launch side-by-side panes (nicer than separate windows). Source: substrate/skills/team-launcher/launch-team.ps1; gauntlet-setup skill references it. Per the launch-discipline HARD RULE (fix the script, do not hand-roll).
title: [BUG] launch-team.ps1 panes/tabs append multi-word activation prompts UNQUOTED (gauntlet had to use -Layout Windows)
